Title: Đăng nhập không hợp lệ
Objective: Từ chối đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu sai
Precondition: Snipe-IT v8.8.0 is running; enduser account exists
Input and Steps: Enter valid username enduser and an incorrect password; submit the login form
Expected Result: Login is rejected and no protected content or access is granted

Title: Truy cập khi chưa đăng nhập
Objective: Yêu cầu xác thực khi truy cập trang quản trị
Precondition: Clear browser cookies; local instance is running
Input and Steps: Request an approved protected asset or user-management URL without logging in
Expected Result: System requires login or denies access without exposing protected data

Title: Kiểm tra phiên đăng nhập
Objective: Kiểm tra cookie phiên sau đăng nhập
Precondition: A dedicated test account is available
Input and Steps: Sign in with enduser account; inspect the session cookie attributes in the HTTP response
Expected Result: Session cookie uses the configured secure attributes and does not expose sensitive information

Title: Kiểm tra quyền truy cập tài sản
Objective: Kiểm tra tài khoản thiếu quyền không truy cập tài nguyên
Precondition: Both admin and enduser accounts exist
Input and Steps: Sign in as enduser and request the user-management page directly
Expected Result: Access is denied or limited according to assigned permissions; no unauthorized data is shown

Title: Kiểm tra quyền chỉnh sửa tài sản
Objective: Kiểm tra End-User không được cập nhật tài sản
Precondition: A sample asset exists and enduser has no edit permission
Input and Steps: Sign in as enduser and submit or request an asset edit operation
Expected Result: Operation is denied and unauthorized data is not changed

Title: Xem danh sách tài sản
Objective: Kiểm tra tài khoản được phép xem danh sách tài sản
Precondition: Admin and sample assets are available
Input and Steps: Sign in with authorized account; open Assets and verify the sample records
Expected Result: Authorized account receives only the asset data within its permissions

Title: Nhập dữ liệu tài sản không hợp lệ
Objective: Kiểm tra validation khi nhập/sửa tài sản
Precondition: Assets module is available and test data can be reset
Input and Steps: Submit an asset with a missing required field or invalid format
Expected Result: Invalid data is rejected; validation is clear; no invalid record is saved

Title: Truy cập API chưa xác thực
Objective: Từ chối request API không có authentication
Precondition: API endpoint is confirmed in scope
Input and Steps: Send an API request without credentials or token to a protected endpoint
Expected Result: Protected API data is not returned; response follows authentication error handling

Title: Gửi tham số API không hợp lệ
Objective: Kiểm tra API xử lý tham số sai định dạng
Precondition: A protected endpoint and valid test token are available
Input and Steps: Send a missing parameter or invalid format to the in-scope API endpoint
Expected Result: API validates input and returns an appropriate error without internal details

Title: Kiểm tra thuộc tính cookie
Objective: Quan sát cookie sau đăng nhập
Input and Steps: Sign in as enduser or admin; inspect session and XSRF cookie attributes
Expected Result: Attributes are consistent with local production configuration; Secure is not required over local HTTP unless HTTPS is configured

Title: Kiểm tra HTTP Security Headers
Objective: Đánh giá security headers bằng OWASP ZAP
Precondition: Snipe-IT local instance and ZAP scope are confirmed
Input and Steps: Run passive collection and inspect response headers for the approved target
Expected Result: Security headers are evaluated using the documented context; missing headers are recorded and verified

Title: Quét bảo mật bằng OWASP ZAP
Objective: Thu thập và phân tích cảnh báo trong phạm vi local
Precondition: Local target/context is fixed; reset procedure is available; active scan is approved
Input and Steps: Configure target in ZAP; run passive scan; run controlled active scan only after scope review
Expected Result: Alerts are recorded and classified; findings are independently verified and false positives are not reported as confirmed defects
